sources.text: semi-cooked raw-milk summer alpine cheese from Val Formazza (Ossola) pastures above 1500 m; branded after at least 60 days; PAT, not DOP; ONAF sheet mentions cow milk only, goat share minor/unconfirmed; max estimated

facts.v: High summer alpine pastures above 1,800 m in Ossola (upper Val Formazza, Antigorio and Devero valleys)
Whole milk heated on the pasture, pressed under stones, salted, then aged at least two months in stone huts called Speicher
